brief: How to build an email funnel that converts at 9%.

slots.title: Email funnel blueprint
slots.ctaText: Build emails that sell while you sleep

slots.title: Pick One Problem
slots.body: Stop trying to solve everything for everyone. Choose a painful, specific problem your audience Googles at 2am. The tighter the niche, the higher the conversion.

slots.title: Bribe The Signup
slots.body: Your lead magnet needs to feel like a cheat code, not a chore. Make it stupidly actionable so they open your first email already trusting you.

slots.title: Write One Welcome
slots.body: The welcome sequence is where the magic happens. Hit them with story, value, and a soft pitch within the first three days while attention is hot.

slots.title: Segment With Clicks
slots.body: Stop blasting the same message to your entire list. Tag subscribers based on what they click so every offer feels like it was written just for them.

slots.title: Sell With Stories
slots.body: Nobody likes a pitch slap. Wrap your offer in quick relatable stories and social proof so the sale feels like a natural next step, not a hard shove.

slots.title: Audit Monthly Data
slots.body: A 9% funnel isn't built in a day. Check your open rates, click rates, and revenue per email once a month then tweak the weakest link first.

slots.headline: Build Your Funnel Now
slots.body: Steal this framework and start building today. Your 9% conversion rate is closer than you think.
